messages:
maria: Quick—I'm assembling a short one-pager and launch checklist for an enterprise kickoff. Need security + SLA callouts, deploy-mode benefits, a 90s benchmark narrative that is careful with claims, and a webinar CTA. Can folks review and add what they need? :pray:

sam: I can take hero voice and the PDF micro layout. Aim for two hero variants: one security-first and one platform-first. Keep benchmark bullet neutral (avoid absolutes).

leo: For the benchmark copy include three compact points only: median token latency on a mid-sized RLHF workload, typical Dedicated throughput for concurrent streams, and fallback behavior when pinned models are absent. Keep the language cautious.

jamie: Field request: inbound form must tag leads with "enterprise-security" and "deploy-mode-interest". If they pick Private, route to AE queue X and SE Y. Also add company-size and compliance fields to drive routing.

anna: Sales wants a clear, low-friction CTA: a 15-min "prod-fit" call. Webinar should be framed as technical deep-dive + live Q&A, not a pitch.

maria: Draft hero options:
Variant 1 (security-first): "Predictable inference for regulated apps — SLA-backed latency, private deployments, and audit trails."
Variant 2 (platform-first): "Inference that scales — predictable throughput, automated fallbacks, and workload-aware cost controls."
Which lands?

sam: Use both: Variant 2 for platform teams, Variant 1 as a small sub-CTA aimed at security/compliance readers.

leo: Add a short rollout caveat: "Pin model versions and set canary rollouts; if a pinned model is unavailable, requests fall back to the nearest compatible variant to preserve availability."

maria: Benchmark narrative (careful tone): "Internal tests showed Dedicated pools sustaining hundreds of requests per minute with low median token latencies on mid-sized LLMs. Hosted autoscaling achieved comparable tail latency in single-tenant scenarios. Workload-aware prefix caching reduced token spend in our test sets by ~20%+." Keep it high-level.

jamie: Add a short anecdote line for field use: "Early fintech and health customers reported smoother rollouts when using Private with KMS + audit logging." Mark as anecdotal.

anna: Form fields to capture: company size, compliance (HIPAA / SOC2 / FedRAMP), desired deploy mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), primary use case. If Private selected, show "KMS/HSM required? yes/no" to trigger routing.

maria: Landing page microcopy draft:
Hero: Variant 2
Subline: "Reduce unit cost while meeting latency SLOs — tune routing, caching, and quantization per workload."
Bullets:
- SLA-backed Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput
- Private VPC & on-prem options with KMS/HSM integrations
- Model and quantization recommendations tuned by workload
CTAs: [Request 15-min prod-fit] [Watch Benchmark Deep-Dive]

sam: For the one-pager PDF request a small 3-column visual comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private with one-line benefit calls: "time-to-value", "predictability", "data control". Also include a tiny tech note block.

leo: Tech note (2-3 lines) for PDF:
Serving runtime: GPU-optimized kernels, continuous batching, KV cache.
Smart routing: policy-based model selection + automated fallback to compatible variants.
Observability: per-route token & latency breakdowns, rollout tracing, and eval regressions.

maria: Webinar plan (30-45m):
- 5m: positioning + problem statement
- 10m: benchmark narrative + short Dedicated demo
- 10m: privacy & SLA deep dive (KMS, audit logs, routing policies)
- 10m: customer lightning use cases (fintech / health)
- 5-10m: live Q&A focused on benchmarks and rollouts
Pre-webinar survey: capture expected scale and compliance to tailor examples.

jamie: Inbound routing rules suggestion: tag leads by form answers; scoring rule: if company_size > 1000 AND compliance in (HIPAA, FedRAMP) => AE-high-priority + SE assigned. Otherwise standard nurture flow. Hook via webhook to SFDC/Hubspot.

maria: Email subject A/B options for blast: "New: predictable LLM inference with enterprise SLAs" and "How we reduced inference unit cost without sacrificing latency — benchmark recap". Suggest A/B test both.

anna: Email CTA should link to the one-pager PDF, the prod-fit calendar, and the tagged intake form. Design the form to auto-apply routing tags.

sam: I'll own hero and PDF visual. Timeline: final copy EOD Wednesday.

leo: I'll run legal review on the benchmark language today and flag edits.

jamie: I'll draft routing + webhook mapping once fields are finalized.

ops-bot: deploy-note: landing page branch created: `marketing/enterprise-kickstart-1719992222` — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/enterprise-kickstart-preview :rocket:

maria: Final ask — include explicit fallback microcopy on the one-pager: "If a pinned model is unavailable, requests will be served from the nearest compatible variant to preserve availability." Agreed?

sam: Yes — lock copy and ping design for the final export.

anna: If we get early signups, please prioritize demo slots the week after the webinar; I'll block preferred times.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update the draft with agreed hero variant, benchmark phrasing, form fields, and routing rules. Will upload final PDF by Wednesday EOD. :clap:
